actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
  d.donation_id,
  d.created_at,
  d.contributor_id,
  d.member_id,
  d.donor_kind,
  d.provider,
  d.provider_reference AS actual_provider_reference,
  CASE
    WHEN d.provider = 'cash' AND d.donor_kind = 'anonymous'
      THEN 'Anonymous'
    WHEN d.provider = 'cash' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
      THEN c.display_name
    ELSE d.provider_reference
  END AS provider_reference,
  c.contributor_type,
  c.display_name AS contributor_name,
  d.amount_cents,
  d.currency,
  d.donated_at,
  d.notes,
  d.status,
  d.facilitator_id,
  d.reviewer_id,
  d.reviewed_at,
  d.review_notes,
  al.details AS details
FROM public.donations d
LEFT JOIN public.contributor_profiles c
  ON c.contributor_id = d.contributor_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.details
  FROM public.audit_log x
  WHERE x.entity_type = 'donation'
    AND x.entity_id = d.donation_id::text
    AND jsonb_exists(x.details, 'raw')
  ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.audit_log_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) al ON TRUE
WHERE d.status = 'pending_review'
  AND (
    (
      d.provider = 'cash'
      AND d.donor_kind IN ('identified', 'anonymous')
    )
    OR
    (
      d.provider = 'givebutter'
      AND d.donor_kind = 'unresolved'
      AND d.contributor_id IS NULL
      AND d.member_id IS NULL
    )
  )
ORDER BY d.donated_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.created_at DESC;
